tech.summary: SK Hynix reported record Q3 revenue of 104.61 trillion won and operating profit of 83.33 trillion won ($62.8B), up 327.9% and 557.2% year-on-year, driven by high-bandwidth memory chips for AI accelerators. It was the company's sixth straight record quarter, and it also announced a fresh 60 trillion won shareholder return plan.
tech.title: SK Hynix posts record Q3 profit as AI memory demand explodes

tech.summary: Bank of America, Blackstone, Citi and Morgan Stanley will provide $63 billion in financing through a special-purpose vehicle to buy Broadcom AI accelerators and networking gear, which will be leased to Anthropic. Deliveries begin in 2027. Anthropic also filed for a potentially record-breaking IPO this week.
tech.title: Wall Street banks line up $63B to buy Anthropic's Broadcom AI chips

tech.summary: OpenAI plans to buy Google's Tensor Processing Units, The Information reported, deepening ties between two AI rivals. OpenAI is one of Nvidia's largest GPU buyers and began renting Google's chips in June 2025; Google's TPUs are gaining traction as a cheaper alternative to Nvidia hardware. Neither company commented.
tech.title: OpenAI plans to buy Google's AI chips, deepening a rival partnership

tech.summary: Apple announced a November Creator Studio update adding beta AI assistants to Pages, Keynote and Numbers that understand the open document, plus Model Context Protocol support letting outside AI agents read and edit files on Mac. Final Cut Pro gains built-in MotionVFX, and Logic Pro gets its own assistant. New subscribers pay $12.99/month.
tech.title: Apple's Creator Studio update brings AI assistants to Pages, Keynote and Numbers

tech.summary: Physical Intelligence, founded in 2024 by former Google DeepMind researchers and Stanford/UC Berkeley academics, is in talks to raise at least $1 billion at a valuation near $20 billion, almost double its $11.5 billion valuation earlier this year, Bloomberg reported. The company, backed by CapitalG, Jeff Bezos and Thrive, currently has no revenue.
tech.title: Robot startup Physical Intelligence in talks to raise $1B at up to $20B valuation

tech.summary: The Nasdaq closed up 1.18% at 26,477.81 as AI semiconductor stocks rallied for a second day on Anthropic's IPO filing and its $63 billion chip-financing news. Broadcom rose about 4%, AMD about 5.5% and Micron 2.8%, while investors still watch Fed policy and Big Tech earnings this week.
tech.title: AI rally enters second day as Nasdaq jumps 1.2% on Anthropic optimism

pakistan.summary: The federal government cut petrol by Rs3.19 per litre to Rs376.06 for October 28 under the daily pricing mechanism, while high-speed diesel rose Rs2.25 to Rs398.07. The cut follows a Rs1.54 petrol hike a day earlier; petrol has now been cut 30 times and raised 38 times since daily pricing began on July 17.
pakistan.title: Petrol cut by Rs3.19 to Rs376.06, diesel up Rs2.25 to Rs398.07 for Oct 28

pakistan.summary: Sri Lanka bowled Pakistan out for just 110 at Gaddafi Stadium, Lahore, then chased it in 18.1 overs to reach the ODI tri-series final. Dilshan Madushanka took a career-best 5-34 and Kamindu Mendis finished 62 not out. The result knocked England out, and Pakistan meet Sri Lanka again in the final on October 31.
pakistan.title: Sri Lanka thrash Pakistan by 8 wickets to reach tri-series final, England out

pakistan.summary: The PCB confirmed opener Saim Ayub has been released from the men's ODI squad for the rest of the tri-series after he asked to return to domestic cricket to work on his batting form. Ayub had not reached double figures in three tri-series innings; Sahibzada Farhan replaces him.
pakistan.title: Saim Ayub released from ODI squad to rediscover form in domestic cricket

pakistan.summary: SUPARCO, with UNOOSA, ISNET and APSCO, opened a five-day international conference in Islamabad (Oct 27-31) on using space technology for early warning, climate action and disaster risk assessment. Around 250 participants from 20 countries are attending, with Planning Minister Ahsan Iqbal as chief guest.
pakistan.title: SUPARCO opens UN-Pakistan space conference on early warning and climate action

pakistan.summary: The government raised the threshold for banks to trigger currency transaction reports to the State Bank's Financial Monitoring Unit by 50%, from Rs2 million to Rs3 million. The Aurangzeb-led anti-money laundering committee also gave the Pakistan Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority powers under the Anti-Money Laundering Act.
pakistan.title: Govt raises currency transaction report threshold to Rs3m in AML review

pakistan.summary: Pakistan Petroleum Ltd posted Rs99 billion profit after tax and record collections of Rs284 billion in FY26, its 75th AGM heard. The company made 11 discoveries adding 242 BCF to reserves, drilled 11 wells, and approved a total dividend of 120%, while expanding into minerals and offshore blocks.
pakistan.title: PPL earns Rs99bn profit, makes 11 discoveries in FY26
